name: prompt_for_language_selection
description: Prompts the user to select their preferred language for communication.

parameters.name: selected_language
parameters.description: The language in which the user wants to communicate.

children.name: prompt_for_privacy_policy_acceptance
children.description: Requests the user to confirm acceptance or decline of the privacy policy before proceeding with assistance.

parameters.name: privacy_policy_acceptance
parameters.description: User's acceptance or decline of the privacy policy.

children.name: present_transport_help_options
children.description: Presents a list of public transportation assistance topics that the user can select from, including train schedules, fare recommendations, directions to stations, transport card information, network status, and facility inquiries.

outputs.description: A list of inquiries the chatbot can assist with, including nearby trains, recommended fares, transport card details, directions to stations, service status, upcoming trains, and installation status.

children.name: prompt_for_fare_information
children.description: Asks the user questions sequentially to recommend the best fare based on user responses.

parameters.name: user_age_group
parameters.description: The age group of the user.

children.name: present_available_services
children.description: Lists the possible services the chatbot can assist with related to travel and fare inquiries.

outputs.description: Consulting upcoming trains, recommended fares, transportation card info, directions to a station, network status, installation status, and other queries.

name: present_line_options
description: Displays available metro line options at a specified station and prompts the user to select one.

parameters.name: selected_line
parameters.description: User's selected metro line to receive information about.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: The name of the station where the user is currently located.

outputs.description: A list of metro lines available at the specified station along with their respective directions and arrival times.

name: prompt_for_age_group_selection
description: Prompts the user to specify their age group to recommend appropriate fare options.

parameters.name: age_group
parameters.description: The age group of the user for fare determination.

children.name: prompt_for_departure_zone_selection
children.description: Prompts the user to select their departure zone for the journey, influencing fare recommendations.

parameters.name: fare_zone
parameters.description: The selected fare zone from which the user will begin their journey.

outputs.description: Visual representation of the zones to assist user selection.

name: prompt_for_user_type_selection
description: Requests the user to specify their status as a visitor or a regular user of the Metro system to suggest appropriate fare options.

parameters.name: user_type
parameters.description: Indicates the user's status regarding usage of the Metro system, whether they are a visitor or a regular user.

name: present_transport_card_options
description: The chatbot presents different types of transport cards available to the user.

outputs.description: Types of transport cards including Tarjeta Personal, Tarjeta Multi, Tarjeta Azul, Tarjeta Infantil, and others.

name: provide_metro_map
description: Shares a schematic map of the Madrid Metro system along with travel information between specified stations.

outputs.description: URL to the interactive metro map with origin and destination stations.
Estimated travel time between the specified stations.
Information on whether transfers are required for the journey.
A schematic representation of the Metro network.

name: provide_train_information
description: Provides details about the next arriving trains at a specified station, including lines, directions, and expected arrival times.

parameters.name: selected_line
parameters.description: the train line the user wants to inquire about

outputs.description: Information about upcoming trains, including line numbers, directions, expected arrival times, and wait times.

name: prompt_for_destination_zone_selection
description: Requests the user to specify their destination zone for fare calculation or journey recommendations.

parameters.name: destination_zone
parameters.description: Indicates the user's intended destination zone or fare zone for the user's journey.

name: provide_fare_recommendations
description: Offers tailored fare suggestions based on user inputs for travel, including various ticket options and their respective prices.

outputs.description: A list of travel ticket options, including billete sencillo, 10 viajes, and Título Turístico (available for 1 to 7 days), along with their respective prices for both regular and tourist fares.

name: provide_explanation_for_single_ticket
description: Explains the single ticket, including its options and requirements.

outputs.description: Information about the single ticket's coverage and usage.

name: prompt_for_confirmation_of_doubt_resolution
description: The chatbot asks the user if their question has been resolved.

parameters.name: resolution_confirmation
parameters.description: Whether the user feels their question has been resolved.

name: prompt_for_station_info
description: Prompts the user to specify their station name to provide relevant information about train schedules or facility status.

parameters.name: current_station
parameters.description: The name of the station where the user is located.

name: provide_network_status
description: Informs the user about current incidents affecting the metro network, including specific lines impacted and available services during disruptions.

outputs.description: Details about current incidents affecting the metro network, including specific line numbers, nature of disruptions, circulation interruptions, and substitute services available for affected routes.
Information about substitute bus services available for commuters.

name: prompt_for_destination_station
description: Prompts the user to specify their destination station to provide travel information.

parameters.name: destination_station
parameters.description: The name of the station the user is traveling to.

name: provide_route_details_and_link
description: Provides estimated travel duration and a link to the interactive map for the user's specified route.

outputs.description: Estimated time for the journey or travel duration.
URL to the interactive map for directions or metro map.

name: provide_tourist_ticket_details
description: The chatbot provides detailed information about the Tourist Ticket, including validities and pricing.

outputs.description: Details on the validity periods and corresponding costs of the Tourist Ticket.
